name: Countries
description: Countries and territories with ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 and alpha-3 codes, currency, and the latest World Bank population with its year and source; derived from GeoNames and World Bank open data (CC BY 4.0), with hand-checked name aliases for joining sample databases such as Northwind and Chinook.

source.notes: Derived and modified from the geo reference data vendored in datatug/datatug-demo-project (itself vendored from ingitdb/geo-ingitdb at a874fb0a95183f536cb574a5ccb45e362274eb6d). Country names, ISO codes, continent, capital, area, currency, calling code, TLD and GeoName ID come from GeoNames countryInfo.txt (CC BY 4.0); population is the latest World Bank SP.POP.TOTL observation (CC BY 4.0) with its year; 36 territories have no World Bank observation and keep a NULL population. The undated GeoNames population is not published. Aliases are hand-checked DataTug mapping data. scripts/rebuild-source.py rebuilds the SQLite fixture from the pinned recipe inputs and CI compares its full logical contents with the committed file; SQLite file bytes can vary by SQLite library version. Neither GeoNames nor the World Bank endorses this database.

tableDescriptions.countries: One row per country or territory, keyed by its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code: GeoNames names, codes and currency, and the latest World Bank population with its year and source.
tableDescriptions.country_aliases: Spellings other datasets use for a country (for example Northwind's 'USA' and 'UK'), each mapped to a countries row with its provenance.
tableDescriptions.sources: The data sources of this database with publisher, licence, attribution and the changes made.
tableDescriptions.country_names: Every country name and every alias that differs from a name, for joining a free-text country column to countries.

countries.name: English country name (GeoNames).
countries.continent: GeoNames continent code: AF, AS, EU, NA, OC, SA or AN.
countries.currency_name: Currency name as GeoNames spells it.
countries.country_source_id: Source of the country's names and codes.
countries.population: Total population, World Bank SP.POP.TOTL, for population_year; NULL when the World Bank has no observation.
countries.population_year: Year of the World Bank population observation.
countries.population_source_url: World Bank Indicators API call that returns this observation.

country_aliases.alias: The exact text another dataset uses for the country.
country_aliases.country_iso2: The ISO alpha-2 code of the country the alias means.
country_aliases.source: Which dataset spells it this way and how the match was made.

queries.title: Country of a Northwind ship country
queries.sql: SELECT c.name, c.iso2, c.iso3, c.currency_code, c.population, c.population_year, s.publisher AS population_source FROM country_names n JOIN countries c ON c.iso2 = n.iso2 LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.source_id = c.population_source_id WHERE n.label = 'Canada';

meaning.name: Countries
meaning.description: What the Countries reference database means: countries keyed by ISO 3166-1 code with their currency and dated population, and aliases that map other datasets' country spellings to them. Concepts extend the core country, country-code and population concepts.

concepts.label: Country
concepts.description: A country or territory in this database, keyed by its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

concepts.label: Country currency
concepts.description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency GeoNames lists for the country.

concepts.label: Country population
concepts.description: The World Bank total population of the country in population_year.

measure.formula: The World Bank SP.POP.TOTL value for the country in population_year.

concepts.label: Country alias
concepts.description: A spelling another dataset uses for a country, mapped to that country.
